items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: F.D.R. wasn't the President; this is the President

ctx.x: She named him "Pres" because he said, "She is the President," because she said that Lester was next to F.D.R. He was the President. F.D.R. wasn't the President; this is the President, because few people knew this about Lester. Forget about his color, the complexion of his skin. He was born in Mississippi. It wouldn't have made no difference if he was - The records show that
I always thought he was born in New Orleans.
